recommendation_summary: Act now: put a primary reviewer and a backup reviewer, both authorized, on every PR. One approval from an authorized non-author is enough to merge, and if the primary is out or hasn't reviewed by end of day, the backup approves that same day. Use the existing tracker with no new tool, and measure ready-to-approval time over the next six merges. No optional additions are offered now. Squads/chapters, Jira Align and quarterly workshops are rejected as a portfolio system for many teams, and a portfolio tool is revisited only if a later need arises to prioritize work across several teams.
note: The reply recommends a bounded backup-reviewer fix and rejects the stack in its prose, but none of the four required labels appear, so every record predicate fails.
